name: SGLuna Factorio Server (NPC E2E / Jev Experiment)
author: noreply@ttlouis.space
description: Experimental SGLuna standalone-NPC channel for Jev decision-layer testing. Reinstall resolves the latest experiment/jev-agent-architecture commit to an exact SHA. Use the Main egg for stable servers.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated SGLuna Factorio channel installer: npc-e2e
# Reinstall follows experiment/jev-agent-architecture; restart keeps the installed exact SHA.
# The installer payload is loaded from that same resolved commit, so an egg
# re-import is not required when deployment code changes on the tracked ref.
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
DEFAULT_SOURCE_REF="experiment/jev-agent-architecture"
CHANNEL="npc-e2e"
SOURCE_REF="$DEFAULT_SOURCE_REF"
SOURCE_REF_ORIGIN="default"
if [[ -n "${SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF:-}" ]]; then
  SOURCE_REF="$SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF"
  SOURCE_REF_ORIGIN="sgluna"
elif [[ -n "${AIRI_SOURCE_REF:-}" ]]; then
  SOURCE_REF="$AIRI_SOURCE_REF"
  SOURCE_REF_ORIGIN="airi"
fi
BASE="$(mktemp)"
PATCHED="$(mktemp)"
RESOLUTION="$(mktemp)"
log() { printf '[SGLuna channel:%s] %s\n' "$CHANNEL" "$*"; }
fail() { log "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 78; }
if [[ "$SOURCE_REF_ORIGIN" == "airi" ]]; then log 'Using legacy AIRI_SOURCE_REF compatibility fallback; prefer SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF.'; fi
if [[ -n "${SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF:-}" && -n "${AIRI_SOURCE_REF:-}" && "$SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF" != "$AIRI_SOURCE_REF" ]]; then
  log 'Compatibility warning: SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF overrides conflicting AIRI_SOURCE_REF.'
fi
cleanup() { local code=$?; trap - EXIT; rm -f -- "$BASE" "$PATCHED" "$RESOLUTION"; exit "$code"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM HUP
for tool in bash curl awk grep mktemp rm tr; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || fail "Missing channel installer tool: $tool"; done
[[ -n "$SOURCE_REF" && "$SOURCE_REF" != -* && "$SOURCE_REF" != */../* && "$SOURCE_REF" != ../* && "$SOURCE_REF" != */.. && "$SOURCE_REF" != *' '* ]] || fail 'Invalid SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF'
if [[ "$SOURCE_REF" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]; then
  RESOLVED_SHA="$SOURCE_REF"
else
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 60 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
    --get --data-urlencode "sha=$SOURCE_REF" --data-urlencode 'per_page=1' \
    'https://api.github.com/repos/TTLouis/factorio-npc/commits' --output "$RESOLUTION" \
    || fail "Unable to resolve SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF=$SOURCE_REF"
  RESOLVED_SHA="$(grep -m1 -oE '"sha"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[a-f0-9]{40}"' "$RESOLUTION" | grep -oE '[a-f0-9]{40}' || true)"
  [[ "$RESOLVED_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]] || fail "SGLUNA_SOURCE_REF did not resolve to a commit: $SOURCE_REF"
fi
log "Resolved $SOURCE_REF -> $RESOLVED_SHA"
URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TTLouis/factorio-npc/$RESOLVED_SHA/deploy/pterodactyl/payload-src/installer.sh"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 900 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' "$URL" --output "$BASE" \
  || fail 'Unable to download SGLuna installer payload from resolved source commit'
[[ "$(grep -Ec '^SGLUNA_REF="[a-f0-9]{40}"$' "$BASE")" == 1 && "$(grep -c '^SGLUNA_REF=' "$BASE")" == 1 ]] || fail 'Unexpected SGLUNA_REF assignment contract in resolved installer payload'
[[ "$(grep -Ec '^REVISION="[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"$' "$BASE")" == 1 && "$(grep -c '^REVISION=' "$BASE")" == 1 ]] || fail 'Unexpected REVISION assignment contract in resolved installer payload'
SHORT_SHA="${RESOLVED_SHA:0:12}"
awk -v ref="$RESOLVED_SHA" -v revision="$CHANNEL-$SHORT_SHA" '
  /^SGLUNA_REF=/ { print "SGLUNA_REF=\"" ref "\""; next }
  /^REVISION=/ { print "REVISION=\"" revision "\""; next }
  { print }
' "$BASE" > "$PATCHED"
grep -Fxq "SGLUNA_REF=\"$RESOLVED_SHA\"" "$PATCHED" || fail 'Failed to apply resolved source SHA'
grep -Fxq "REVISION=\"$CHANNEL-$SHORT_SHA\"" "$PATCHED" || fail 'Failed to apply channel release revision'
log "Installing exact source $RESOLVED_SHA from $SOURCE_REF"
bash "$PATCHED"

variables.name: SGLuna Source Ref
variables.description: Git branch, tag, or exact 40-character commit SHA followed when this npc-e2e egg is reinstalled. Restart does not resolve or update this ref.

variables.name: SGLuna Actor Mode
variables.description: Controlled actor mode. The v8 egg intentionally supports standalone NPC ownership only.

variables.name: SGLuna Chat Players
variables.description: Players allowed to issue !luna commands. Default none disables in-game commands until an allowlist is configured. Enter comma-separated exact player names for an allowlist, or use * to explicitly allow everyone. Legacy !airi remains accepted as a compatibility alias.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Provider credential. Kept environment-only and never written to sgluna-config.json.

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: Comma-separated OpenAI-compatible model identifiers. The first entry is the main agent model, used exactly as a single model always was. A second entry names the subagent/plan-agent model for later use; extra entries are validated but otherwise unused today.

variables.name: Provider Base URL
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Replace the non-routable placeholder. The direct and router AI API methods require HTTPS; the local method also allows plain http to localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]/host.docker.internal.

variables.name: AI API Method
variables.description: Wire contract for the AI Model endpoint: direct detects the format from the URL and model; router uses the OpenRouter capability profile; local uses the LM Studio-style local capability profile and allows plain http to localhost/host.docker.internal only. direct and router require HTTPS. Leave blank to keep this server’s existing behaviour unchanged (the legacy Provider Capability Profile, if any was set, keeps working exactly as before).

variables.name: Provider Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Maximum time for one provider response before the SGLuna turn is cancelled and reported in game.

variables.name: TypeSafe API Key
variables.description: Optional Jev/System One decision-provider credential. Leave blank to disable the decision lane. Kept environment-only and never written to sgluna-config.json.

variables.name: Jev Decision Model
variables.description: TypeSafe System One model used for bounded decision routing when a TypeSafe API key is present.

variables.name: Max Jev Requests Per Hour
variables.description: Persisted hourly cap for Jev decision-provider calls. Separate from the main planner provider budget.

variables.name: Save File Name
variables.description: Save under /saves. Leave blank to use the newest existing save or create sgluna-world.zip.

variables.name: Factorio Username
variables.description: Factorio.com username used for public server listing. Leave both username and token blank for a hidden/private server.

variables.name: Factorio Authentication Token
variables.description: Factorio.com authentication token used for public server listing. Leave both username and token blank for a hidden/private server.

variables.name: Max AI Requests Per Hour
variables.description: Persisted hourly provider request cap. Ordinary requests preserve one slot inside this same cap for exactly-once output-budget recovery.

variables.name: Max AI Output Tokens Per Turn
variables.description: Aggregate provider-reported completion-token safety cap across one logical planner turn, including bounded recovery. Missing/incomplete usage remains diagnostic rather than being treated as zero.

variables.name: Shutdown Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Graceful Factorio save/stop timeout before forced termination.

variables.name: Factorio Version
variables.description: Factorio 2.0 headless version: latest, experimental, or exact 2.0.x release.
